snippet.title: Covert Koalas: Phasco - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Covert Koalas: Phasco reveal trailer!

A comfy game where you're searching for hidden koalas on unique hand-drawn levels with adjustable difficulty. Help a group of koalas escape their captivity and follow their story on a search for a new home. Because the world is big enough for all!
